data.name: No Up
data.detailed_description:
No Up is a first-person liminal exploration game set in disorienting, surreal spaces where traditional orientation and gravity cannot be trusted. Players navigate environments where any surface can be walked on, uncovering the logic of each space through observation, movement, and simple interactions rather than combat or complex systems.

Focused on atmosphere and spatial problem-solving, No Up uses minimal text, fully localized prompts, and event-driven puzzles to create an abstract, immersive experience. The game is deliberately linear and tightly scoped, emphasizing mood, perception, and curiosity over challenge or progression, inviting players to explore strange places and understand how they work—one interaction at a time.
